title: Towel Ring 6-Inch Solid Brass With Concealed Mount | Oil Rubbed Bronze | Towel Rings | Allied Brass
description:
Keep a hand towel within easy reach and your vanity area looking pulled together with a clean, space-saving towel ring in Oil Rubbed Bronze, which offers rich, dark brown tones with subtle copper highlights, bringing Old World character to any bathroom.

Highlights:
- Oil Rubbed Bronze brings rich depth and character
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Maintain a crisp, finished appearance with concealed screw mounting hardware
- Coordinate your space with the Towel Rings collection for a cohesive set of versatile bath accessories
- Choose the look you want with multiple designer finish options available

Specs & Installation:
- Product type: Bathroom towel ring
- Material: Solid brass
- Mounting: Concealed screw, wall-mounted
- Diameter/overall dimensions (L x H x W): 6 x 6 x 6 inches
- Box dimensions (L x H x W): 10 x 6 x 4 inches
- Shipping weight: 2 lbs
- Assembly: Assembled in the U.S.A.
